text: Peregrine Lens acquired Fennimore Optics, according to a merger notice filed Monday with the Sable Exchange Authority and a statement from Peregrine chief executive Mara Ilyan. The deal, completed for 480 million crowns in cash and stock, gives Peregrine control of Fennimore’s compact imaging line and its research campus in East Halcyon. Fennimore’s board approved the sale on March 12 after a six-week auction process, the notice said, and shareholders are due to receive 17.40 crowns a share. A person briefed on the transaction said Peregrine plans to keep Fennimore’s 220 staff in place while folding sales and procurement into its broader precision optics division.
